superMetric.name: Capacity - Sum of Oversized MEM - Cluster/Host
Performance - Num of VMs /w PacketDrop gt 0.5%
superMetric.formula: count(${adaptertype=VMWARE, objecttype=VirtualMachine, metric=net:Aggregate of all instances|droppedPct, depth=3, where=($value > 0.5)})

superMetric.name: Maintenance - VM on LocalDisk
superMetric.formula: count(${adaptertype=VMWARE, objecttype=Datastore, metric=capacity|available_space, depth=1, where="summary|isLocal equals true"})

superMetric.name: Capacity - Total Datastore Capacity - vCenter/Cluster/Host
superMetric.formula: sum(${adaptertype=VMWARE, objecttype=Datastore, metric=capacity|total_capacity, depth=5,where="summary|isLocal equals false"})

superMetric.name: Performance - Num of VMs /w CPU Contention gt 5%
Capacity - Sum of Undersized vCPU - Cluster/Host
Capacity - Num of Datastore /wo Local - vCenter/Cluster/Host
superMetric.formula: count(${adaptertype=VMWARE, objecttype=Datastore, metric=summary|isLocal, depth=7, where="summary|isLocal equals false"})

superMetric.name: Capacity - Num of Undersized VM - Cluster/Host
Capacity - Sum of Oversized vCPU - Cluster/Host
Capacity - Num of capacity criteria violations - vCenter/Cluster
superMetric.formula: count(${adaptertype=VMWARE, objecttype=HostSystem, metric=Super Metric|sm_b462f8e3-f0ec-4cf5-ae2d-ddebc7de8135, depth=7,where=">180"})+count(${adaptertype=VMWARE, objecttype=HostSystem, metric=Super Metric|sm_b70712cc-4c40-4ec2-be08-623fb4b31fad, depth=7,where=">90"})+count(${adaptertype=VMWARE, objecttype=Datastore, metric=capacity|usedSpacePct, depth=7,where=">90" && "summary|isLocal equals false"})

superMetric.name: Capacity - Total Datastore Used - vCenter/Cluster/Host
superMetric.formula: sum(${adaptertype=VMWARE, objecttype=Datastore, metric=capacity|used_space, depth=5,where="summary|isLocal equals false"})

superMetric.name: Performance - Num of VMs /w Disk Latency
superMetric.formula: count(${adaptertype=VMWARE, objecttype=VirtualMachine, metric=virtualDisk:Aggregate of all instances|totalLatency, depth=5, where=($value >= 10)})

superMetric.name: Performance - Num of VMs /w CPU Contention
Capacity - CPU Allocation - vCenter/Cluster
superMetric.formula: ceil((sum(${adaptertype=VMWARE, objecttype=HostSystem, metric=cpu|vcpus_allocated_on_all_powered_on_vms, depth=5})/sum(${adaptertype=VMWARE, objecttype=HostSystem, metric=hardware|cpuInfo|num_CpuCores, depth=5}))*100)

superMetric.name: Performance - Num of VMs /w MEM Contention gt 0.1%
Performance - Num of VMs /w Disk Latency gt 20ms
superMetric.formula: count(${adaptertype=VMWARE, objecttype=VirtualMachine, metric=virtualDisk:Aggregate of all instances|totalLatency, depth=5, where=($value >= 20 && $value < 30)})

superMetric.name: Capacity - Total Datastore Usage - vCenter/Cluster/Host
superMetric.formula: ceil((sum(${adaptertype=VMWARE, objecttype=Datastore, metric=capacity|used_space, depth=5,where="summary|isLocal equals false"}))/(sum(${adaptertype=VMWARE, objecttype=Datastore, metric=capacity|total_capacity, depth=5,where="summary|isLocal equals false"}))*100)

superMetric.name: Capacity - Sum of Undersized MEM - Cluster/Host
Performance - Num of VMs /w CPU Contention gt 2.5%
Mgmt - vCenter Alert Count
superMetric.formula: sum(${adaptertype=VMWARE, objecttype=HostSystem, metric=System Attributes|self_alert_count, depth=7})+sum(${adaptertype=VMWARE, objecttype=VirtualMachine, metric=System Attributes|self_alert_count, depth=7})+sum(${adaptertype=VMWARE, objecttype=Datastore, metric=System Attributes|self_alert_count, depth=7})

superMetric.name: Capacity - Num of Oversized VM - Cluster/Host
Capacity - Remaining GB of Mem - Host
Capacity - MEM Allocation - vCenter/Cluster
superMetric.formula: ceil((sum(${adaptertype=VMWARE, objecttype=HostSystem, metric=mem|memory_allocated_on_all_powered_on_vms, depth=5})/sum(${adaptertype=VMWARE, objecttype=HostSystem, metric=mem|host_provisioned, depth=5}))*100)

superMetric.name: Performance - Num of VMs /w CPU Contention gt 10%
Performance - Num of VMs /w Disk Latency gt 30ms
superMetric.formula: count(${adaptertype=VMWARE, objecttype=VirtualMachine, metric=virtualDisk:Aggregate of all instances|totalLatency, depth=5, where=($value >= 30)})

superMetric.name: Capacity - CPU Allocation - Host
Capacity - Remaining Num of vCPUs - Host
Capacity - MEM Allocation - Host
Performance - Num of VMs /w Disk Latency gt 10ms
superMetric.formula: count(${adaptertype=VMWARE, objecttype=VirtualMachine, metric=virtualDisk:Aggregate of all instances|totalLatency, depth=5, where=($value >= 10 && $value < 20)})
